title: Sleigh Run
description: Christmas Eve delivery flight. Steer the sleigh over five snowy towns and lob presents down the chimneys before dawn, dodging treetops, fairy-lit power lines and geese. Gaussian-splat village, sleigh and reindeer.
controls: W/S or Up/Down: climb and dive. Space or click: drop a present. Phone: drag on the left to steer, tap the right to drop. P pauses, M mutes.
